description: Every 30 minutes, checks Cliniko for newly-cancelled appointments across every configured practice. Outside the practice's cancellation window, proposes real open times and raises a WorkQ item with the No-show follow-up approval form attached (reused as-is - see build notes); inside the window, raises a plain alert for the practitioner to handle by hand instead of auto-offering. Nothing is sent until approved.
